title: Higher compact-support images in the common-stage Weil heart
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne p$, an algebraic closure $\Omega$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, finite-type $k_0$-schemes $X_0,Y_0$, and a separated finite-type morphism $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$. Let $c=(j_0,p_0)$ be any compactification [def-nagata-compactification] of $f_0$. Give its middle scheme the structure map $p_0$ followed by that of $Y_0$; it is finite type over $k_0$. Work in the ambient categories of all equivariant ind-sheaves [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], with their canonical inverse image, adjoint open extension and adjoint ordinary direct image. Let $y_X$ denote the fully faithful embedding of the existing common-stage constructible Weil heart [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. For $F$ in that heart and $n\in\mathbf N$, form
$$V_{c,n}(F)=R^n(p_{0,*})\bigl(j_{0,!}(y_X F)\bigr),$$
where the higher right derived functor of the proper direct image is computed by injective resolutions in the ambient equivariant ind-category. Open extension is applied before resolving. Define $R^n_{c}f_!F$ to be the representing object of the existing constructible Weil heart, equipped with $y_Y(R^n_{c}f_!F)\simeq V_{c,n}(F)$. Such a representing object exists; full faithfulness determines it up to unique isomorphism compatible with that representation. For two compactifications the resulting higher images are isomorphic as Weil sheaves.

This is the higher image of the compact-support operation [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. More explicitly, for every finite coefficient field $E\subset\Omega$, every integral constructible model $K$ of the underlying common-stage heart object of $F$, and every geometric compactification of $f$, its underlying heart carrier is isomorphic to $\mathcal H^n$ of the prescribed literal common-stage pair $(E,Rf_{!,E}K)$; cohomology is that of the standard t-structure [def-weil-constructible-heart]. The action is the natural Weil action induced by the proper/open adjunction mates, normalized by the inverse-image comparisons of [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category]. The geometric-fibre structure maps and finite-type/base-change instances are inherited, and $\ell$ is a unit in $k$. If finite type and quasi-compactness of $X_0\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0$ are obtained by composing $f_0$ with the structure map of $Y_0$, the source-heart presentation uses these derived instances, imposing no extra hypothesis. The same convention gives the composite higher image for two composable maps.
